title: Rabbo ayro sadah yan ayyunta
intro: Baddi qaxih guubu fan maaqatta hayis qibaadah amri tattabal inki ayro qibaadah kee waaso. Ta ayyuntih addat tan butta, woo amrih waado, sissin ekraaroh addat, sissin qaynatih ekraarol, sissin qaynatih ekraarol, sissin qaynatih taqabitte kataasak geytimta. too roocitte miyyak sugteeh, keenik maca tekkeeh?
clues: Nanu elle mannownam baddi qaxih xaqul, baddi mano neh xayyoosak sugte.
Nanu ayyaamat inki ayro nassakaxxem amrisenno, baadal tan taamoomik tattabal daffesnaama.
too ayro, kullumti mango ixximal nee fan yemeete, amri diggosnuh nee gibbataanam ceelak.
nanu ekraaro massosne kullumta diini ayroh naharat, lakal ken gaaboysenno is taturteek lakal.
nek baali ta aylahsok takkaawisa wak, nanu ken fayi habballa hayneh garuq luk sugne.
ni qellat, nanu milaagimneh damaaqe, niqnaa kee cinnimteh.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
